title: [Master][All-E] Subcontractor Price ignores Run Time when creating purchase cost for time-based subcontracting operations
summary: Fixed subcontractor pricing for time-based operations by multiplying the subcontractor price by the operation run time factor when creating purchase costs, with comprehensive test coverage.
key_points: Subcontractor price now correctly incorporates operation run time for time-based unit cost calculations
Shared calculation applies consistent pricing across requisition worksheets, purchase lines, and automatic repricing scenarios
Operation time factor multiplied by price and rounded using configured unit-amount precision
Automated tests added for worksheet calculation, carried-out lines, repricing, and direct purchase line creation
quote: Subcontractor Price ignores Run Time when creating purchase cost for time-based subcontracting operations
